name: Crystal Smiles (formerly No Tears Dental)

Listed in Delta Dental, Aetna Better Health NJ and Medicare Advantage dental directories, so it takes a broad mix of insured and Medicaid/Medicare Advantage patients (inference from directory presence).
customers: East Brunswick families, including Medicaid and Medicare Advantage members (directory evidence).

Appears in Aetna Better Health NJ Medicaid/dual-eligible directories

Google profile without a website link - patients and AI assistants cannot verify services, hours or insurance

agent_readiness.notes: Maps shows address, phone, hours and a 4.8 rating, but no website and no booking action. No robots.txt applies (no site). Nothing about services, insurance accepted or pricing exists as readable text anywhere I could reach, so an assistant cannot answer basic questions. No online booking.

operations_signals.signal: 134-review practice handling everything by phone - appointment volume and insurance questions (Medicaid/Medicare Advantage) likely dominate front-desk time (inference from review count and directory mix)
Rebrand without a website means staff must explain the name change and re-verify insurance each call
